description: inspire.lfrz.gv.at: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.lfrz.gv.at. Coverage: the area served by inspire.lfrz.gv.at. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Gebiete mit potenziellem signifikantem Hochwasserrisiko (APSFR); Hochwasserrisikogebiete (APSFR) HQ300, Österreich; Hochwasserüberflutungsflächen HQ30, Österreich; Hochwasserüberflutungsflächen HQ300, Österreich. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, GML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
